title.value: hBert + BiasCorp - Fighting Racism on the Web
title.justification: The title clearly encapsulates the main focus of the paper: introducing hBERT, a model designed to tackle racism on the web using the BiasCorp dataset.
title.quote: In this short piece of work, we present how we’re tackling this societal issue with Natural Language Processing. We are releasing BiasCorp 12 , a dataset containing 139,090 comments and news segment from three specific sources... In this work, we present hBERT, where we modify certain layers of the pretrained BERT model with the new Hopfield Layer.

analysis.description: This paper introduces hBERT, a modification of the BERT model using a Hopfield Layer for improved performance in detecting racially biased content online. It also presents BiasCorp, a dataset with comments and news segments annotated for racial bias. The paper addresses the societal issue of racism on the web using Natural Language Processing techniques and releases tools to aid in the identification of racially biased contents.

type.justification: The paper involves empirical work through the implementation and evaluation of the hBERT model and the use of the BiasCorp dataset.
type.quote: We fine-tune the pretrained BERT model on our curated dataset rather than training from scratch (this choice was based on empirical results).
